meta.title: Bulk-assign several PR line items at once

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions page where the PR line items and assignment controls are available.

args.goal: On the Purchase Requisitions page, find a PR with several unassigned line items, select multiple line items using their left-side checkboxes while leaving at least one line item unselected, click Add Assignee, choose an available user from the dropdown, and verify on the resulting PR table that every selected line item's Assignee column shows the chosen user while each unselected line item's Assignee value remains unchanged.

steps.note: Perform and verify the bulk assignment because no catalog step can select PR line items and use Add Assignee.
Confirm the resulting PR screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or invalid rendered values.
